prediction_rule: predicted hallucinated iff the verifier output has at least one CONTRADICTED or UNSUPPORTED claim
failure_handling: main result: a failed case is always wrong (gold positive -> missed, gold negative -> false alarm); `excluding_failures` drops failed cases (paired comparisons then use the cases both methods completed)
conclusion_wording_rule: "A is better than B" may be written only if the 95% interval of the paired difference excludes 0; otherwise write "no evidence of a difference" and give the interval. Never write "equally good".
